title: Staryu Can Survive Being Chopped Apart
premise: Staryu can regrow its entire body after being chopped apart, as long as its red core survives.
audiencePromise: See the one part Staryu cannot lose, and how fast its body can return.
openLoop: What part of Staryu has to survive the attack?
payoff: Staryu's red core is the reset button. Protect it, and its body can return in half a day.
engagementQuestion: Would you battle with Staryu, or protect its core?

voice.instructions: Speak like a knowledgeable fan sharing a shocking fact. Keep the pace quick, warm, and clear. Stress red core and chopped apart. Let each reveal land with a brief pause.

scenes.headline: CHOP STARYU APART
scenes.narration: Chop Staryu apart. Its red core brings it back.
scenes.caption: THE CORE BRINGS IT BACK

scenes.headline: PROTECT THE RED CORE
scenes.narration: Its glowing red core is the one part that must survive.
scenes.caption: THE CORE MUST REMAIN INTACT

scenes.headline: THE BODY CAN REGROW
scenes.narration: Lose limbs, tear the body, and Staryu can regenerate them.
scenes.caption: TORN BODY. REGENERATING LIMBS.

scenes.headline: CHOPPED TO BITS
scenes.narration: Chopped to bits, Staryu can still grow back around its core.
scenes.caption: THE CORE REBUILDS EVERYTHING

scenes.headline: BACK IN HALF A DAY
scenes.narration: It can return to its previous state in half a day.
scenes.caption: PREVIOUS STATE: HALF A DAY

scenes.headline: BATTLE OR PROTECT?
scenes.narration: Would you battle with Staryu, or protect its core?
scenes.caption: BATTLE WITH IT OR PROTECT IT?
